name: Synn
message: 「Huh. You're not going out for cake today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweets!! If it came out of the club budget, I'd go every single day!!」
Considering Nanaka's health, I definitely don't want to pay for that.

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, sweets. I wanna eat some too~ Nanaka, treat me~~」

name: Synn
message: 「If you eat too much, you'll get fat」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't care~ If it makes my boobs bigger, bring it on!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It might make your belly bigger instead, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then whenever you eat sweets, split 'em half-and-half with me. Problem solved!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet. So good your cheeks will practically melt off!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek!! My cheeks festering and burning right off?! That's way too scary, I could never eat that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exactly! So if you ever happen to find any sweets, I'll dispose of them for you」

name: Sally
message: 「H-How kind of you... Got it! If I find any, I'll bring them straight to you!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hehehe~ Those two idiots are heading right over without a clue, Boss」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Sally. Where do you live, anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're having curry again tonight, what about you, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You have to make sure to let your family know」

name: Synn
message: 「They might be making dinner for you, and besides, I think they'd worry」

name: Sally
message: 「Nobody makes dinner for me anyway, so it's totally fine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……Was it bad to bring up this kind of topic?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe…… Alright! Then along with the curry, I'll treat you to my homemade cake」

name: Sally
message: 「Eeeeeek. I don't want it, I don't want it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Milkshakes, that slushy texture is so good though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yours is just frozen milk, isn't it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha……! You're more grown-up than you look, Sally-chan」

name: Sally
message: 「Wait, no, no, not at all! The one I wanted to meet was…… um, u~~m\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「To think it'd ignore me for you--it must really like you, Sally-chan」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp!! Could it be... this thing ate Boss...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. Sasami only eats grass and worms」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuu, mission failed. Well, at least I get to eat dinner, so whatever\s07」
Sally-chan flopped right down onto her back.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey now. Don't think you can eat for free--those who don't work don't eat, you know」

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah, meanie~! I'll do it, so gimme dinner」

name: Synn
message: 「Alrighty. Allow me to put my skills to the test and whip up some delicious curry」
Healthy vegetable curry. It's a classic staple that makes up half the meals at the Sakura household.
Nanaka has gone over ten years without knowing this curry has milk in it.
And then there's Sally, shedding tears like a waterfall out of sheer joy.

name: Sally
message: 「Being able to eat something this delicious makes me way too happy~」

name: Synn
message: 「You're exaggerating. Still, even if it's flattery, I'm glad--thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sure, Synn's curry is good and all, but there are plenty of other delicious foods out there, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that's a different kind of delicious, or how should I put it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Be grateful for life. Anything edible is delicious」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah! That's right, it's all about the sauce」

name: Synn
message: 「Want to try putting some sauce on it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Putting sauce on curry rice is pure heresy, just like putting nori on soba!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did she put too much sauce on?」

name: Sally
message: 「Haah... So this is the joy of eating\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, she cleaned the bath for me」

name: Sally
message: 「If I get to eat food this delicious, I'll clean the bath or do anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then maybe I should just have you live in and work here, ahaha」

name: Sally
message: 「Alright, it's decided! I'm living here starting today」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on now. That was just a light jok--」

name: Sally
message: 「As for my room... eh, whatever. I'll pick one later」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, Sally-chan? Are you sure it's okay to just suddenly move in?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. Totally fine. I don't even have a home in the first place」

name: Sally
message: 「I do have an open-air hideout, though... oops, that's a secret\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... so that's how it is... Somehow, I'm starting to feel a real kinship with you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. A guy and a girl under the same roof... huh」

name: Sally
message: 「Uff~n\s04 Don't look my sexy body up and down like that, oh my~\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if it's Sally-chan, she'll probably be fine」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Already seducing a demon woman, just as expected of you, Synn-sama」
And so, Sally-chan ended up living at the Grand Palace.
